adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, calendar references were refactored from a single reference to an array (`calendarReference = ...filter(...)` and looped for updates). However, in the reschedule-merge cleanup path it still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));` and thus would only delete one old calendar event when multiple `_calendar` references exist (one per host). This can leave stale/orphaned events on other hosts’ calendars.
